title: RateMyProfessor Department Rating Analysis
description: Processed 1.35M+ professor reviews into 10,686 professor-period observations across 40 universities, using Python and pandas to analyze department-level rating differences.
highlights: Applied multiple linear regression and stratified Kruskal-Wallis tests, finding that STEM professors rated 0.56 points lower than humanities professors after adjusting for review volume, school group and time period.

Analyzed rating differences across four university groups and COVID versus non-COVID periods, finding that department gaps persisted across most subgroups while COVID period alone was not a significant predictor.

title: BuildVCT - VALORANT Roster Draft & Tournament Simulator
description: Built a data pipeline to scrape, clean and structure match and player statistics from 16 esports tournaments, covering 390+ matches and 1,000+ player stat lines.
highlights: Developed a seeded, map-by-map tournament simulation engine using ratings derived from historical match data, alongside a Redis-backed daily leaderboard.
Deployed an interactive roster-drafting application attracting thousands of viewers and reaching 200 concurrent users at peak.
